summary: Comprehensive review of Backyard Ultra Santo Domingo app completed. All core functionality verified working: Homepage, Navigation (7 links + Anteriores dropdown), Mi Perfil (login, dashboard with 4 tabs in correct order, edit profile, logout), Password Reset flow, Admin panel login and access, Static pages (/evento, /corredores, /voluntarios, /reglas, /logistica, /patrocinadores). Historical race data (BYSD-2026) accessible via Anteriores dropdown.

issues: Race filter dropdown exists but data-testid='messages-race-filter' not found - minor selector issue only

critical_code_review_comments: All routes properly configured in App.js - no duplicate routes issue
Tab order correct: Mis Datos -> Próximas Carreras -> Historial -> Mensajes (conditional)
show_tracking_page and show_community_page are False - so Resultados and Comunidad links not shown for active race (only visible under Anteriores)
show_preregistration is True - Inscribirme button visible in Mi Perfil
Admin panel has all tabs: Control, Vueltas, Escáner QR, Atletas, Voluntarios, Turnos, Patrocinadores, Encuesta, Correos, Usuarios, Carrera
context_for_next_testing_agent: App fully functional. Test athlete Juan Pérez has claimed BYSD-2026 result (BIB #002, 4 vueltas, DNF), has 1 cheer message from Carlos Pérez, profile_complete=true. Historical race BYSD-2026 shows winner Livio Feliz (BIB #090, 2 vueltas). Active race is BYSD-2027. Page visibility: show_tracking=false, show_community=false, show_preregistration=true.
